Adaptations made on 2026-10-09 cover achievement definitions and conditions,
the underground achievements view, house and records view, trash piles,
the main menu's selectable house background and leaderboard sign, and
Reanimation::SetImageDefinition. The hooks were replaced with
native C++ classes, mouse/keyboard/gamepad input, and local profile persistence.
